title: The edition is stale (site still shows edition 0.22.50, data_as_of 27 Oct 19:13 UTC): this session cannot start the press's edition build
note: Dev, 28 October 2026 about 22:10 UTC. Press attached with push access; workflow_dispatch of edition.yml (force=true, ref dev) is refused: 403 Resource not accessible by integration (the session's GitHub token has no Actions: write). The press keeps no board or changelog line, and every press release goes to security's review, so no change was made. To unstick, either: (a) the editor runs 'Build the edition' by hand in the press's Actions tab (no force needed), or (b) the editor's go for a minimal press release by dev. Afterwards each of data, site, updates, refs and team takes the edition on its next push (workflow_dispatch of 'Deploy to GitHub Pages' needs the same Actions: write). Last edition run: press Actions run 40605729498 (27 Oct, success). | Dev, 28 October 22:50 UTC, a second session (session_015gaHdeQPc82wWvW99oY7RT, on the editor's own ask): the same dispatch (edition.yml, ref dev, force=true) is refused again, 403 Resource not accessible by integration, and so was a dispatch of team's pages.yml on 28 October 01:3x UTC: this account's GitHub integration cannot start workflows in any of the six. Nothing else was tried and no commit was pushed to force a run. What the editor does: open the press's Actions tab, 'Build the edition', Run workflow, ref dev, force ticked. When it ends, each of data, site, updates, refs and team takes the edition on its next push (or his 'Run workflow' on its 'Deploy to GitHub Pages'). State before: sites serve edition 0.22.50 (now.json site 0.22.50, data_as_of 2026-10-27T19:13Z) while data is at 0.1.108 and the press at 1.0.85; release.json: site 0.22.61, refs 0.22.48, updates 0.22.51, team 0.55.28. | Correction, dev, 28 October 2026 (the editor asked): 'force ticked' above was wrong to ask for. The workflow's force input (tools/edition.sh, EDITION_FORCE) only skips the check 'nothing released by anyone since the last edition'; agents have released many times since edition 0.22.50 (data 0.1.108, team, site, press), so a plain 'Run workflow', ref dev, nothing ticked, builds. The input is also not a git force-push, which no agent or person does here: a force-push, or any need to force something through, is a sign that something went wrong and is looked at before anything is forced. Never force-push; if a build seems to need force, find why it says 'nothing new' first. | Update, dev, 28 October 23:10 UTC: the editor gave the go to start the build with a signed log pushed to the press (log/edition-triggers/20261028T2300Z__dev__session_015gaHdeQPc82wWvW99oY7RT.md and .sig, press 10e6e78). It started 'Build the edition' run 9, which built 1,411 pages and FAILED the gate on six items in two files that are not the press's: security's scan.py (board dev-0014) and observability's harness.html (dev-0015). Nothing was published; the live sites are as before. Next: those two owners fix their files, then a build is started again (by a push to the press, or the editor's run of the workflow); the edition has been blocked since 27 October by anything that fails the gate, not only by the missing trigger.
